channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Here's the inflation breakdown for July 2026 — in one chart
item.description: Costs remain elevated for consumers, however inflation is showing some signs of easing, economists say.

item.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
item.description: Beyond the big single-month jump, the collective red ink over the 10 months of the fiscal year rose to nearly $1.8 trillion, surpassing the same period in 2025.

item.title: 'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
item.description: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.

item.title: S&P 500 rises after tame inflation data; AI-related shares jump: Live updates
item.description: Investors are bracing for an important inflation report that could determine the near-term direction for interest rates.

item.title: Starbucks is close to the top of its multiyear range. The charts show it could break out higher
item.description: Frank Cappelleri breaks down the technicals on the coffee chain.

item.title: Trump sued over Truth Social advance access sale
item.description: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, notes that Trump's posts on his own social media site often move financial markets.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz ship traffic near three-month low as U.S.-Iran deal in doubt
item.description: Traffic is about 90% lower than the daily average of 130 ships that transited Hormuz before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: SpaceX short sellers are running out of bullets as stock rebounds more than 30% off low
item.description: Short interest in SpaceX fell to about 11% of the company's publicly traded shares Wednesday, down sharply from a peak of 34% last week, according to S3.

item.title: Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner buy Los Angeles Lakers at a $12.5 billion valuation, source says
item.description: Venture capital founder Joshua Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger acquire Mark Walter's stake in Los Angeles Lakers at valuation of more than $12 billion.

item.title: Trump officials float cut to capital gains tax on home sales. What it could mean for homeowners
item.description: Trump officials may be considering a tax break for homeowners selling their primary residence in the lead up to the midterm elections.

item.title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
item.description: The China Passenger Car Association released data Tuesday showing penetration of new energy vehicles rose in July. Tesla's Model Y remained popular.

item.title: China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus makes first international flight — could COMAC challenge the aviation duopoly?
item.description: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.

item.title: The stock market's tranquility is almost unprecedented. That's a red flag for Michael Burry
item.description: The high-profile investor said major market cycles can take months or even years to unfold, making timing them dangerous for investors using leverage.

item.title: How to best play a vitally important AI infrastructure cog using options
item.description: While the valuation is clearly not cheap, the profitability profile is extraordinary for a hardware company.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Wendy's, H&R Block, Quantinuum, CoreWeave, Cava & more
item.description: These are the stocks posting the largest moves midday.

item.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
item.description: Google is launching the Pixel 11 lineup weeks before Apple rolls out a rebuilt Siri powered by Gemini AI models.

item.title: Amazon shares appear stuck in a rut. Trader Mike Khouw is betting things will stay that way
item.description: For investors who suspect Amazon could be range-bound for the next seven weeks, consider a “jade lizard.”

item.title: Small investors became a major stock market force. Now, they risk getting pushed back into the dark
item.description: Retail investors' access to information could take a hit at a time when they are more important than ever in financial markets.

item.title: Wendy's stock jumps on report of potential takeover bid from Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management
item.description: Peltz's relationship with Wendy's dates back to an activist campaign he led more than two decades ago.

item.title: Trust, but hedge: Quietly violent summer lingers as bulls buy crash protection
item.description: It's been a wild summer for stocks, even if it may not feel like it at surface level.

item.title: The S&P paces to snap a 2-day skid, and Goldman beefs up its asset management unit
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Americans have effectively taken a pay cut. 5 financial tools to make your dollars go further
item.description: Inflation outpaced wage growth, meaning you have less buying power than a year ago. Here's how to stretch your money.

item.title: Mortgage rates finally stop rising, causing demand to trickle back
item.description: Mortgage rates finally eased a tiny bit, but it was enough to bring some demand back to a very beleaguered mortgage market.

item.title: CoreWeave surges 18% after a 'cleaner quarter.' Here's what's happening
item.description: AI cloud giant CoreWeave jumped in premarket trading after reporting that its second-quarter revenue doubled on surging AI demand from hyperscalers.

item.title: Solar eclipse drives Europe hotel prices to over $1,000 a night
item.description: Eclipse demand pushed some Spain and Iceland stays above $1,000 a night, while Iceland hotels cut prices sharply closer to Aug. 12.

item.title: Meta and Nvidia plant 'very firm flag' in open-weight AI race led by Chinese Labs
item.description: With China way ahead in the market for open-weight models, Meta and Nvidia are both doing what they can to put the U.S. on the map.

item.title: Home Depot CEO taking temporary medical leave, two top execs to run the retailer
item.description: Home Depot's CEO, Ted Decker, is taking a temporary medical leave of absence that's expected to last a few months.

item.title: AI’s costly build-out complicates the Fed’s inflation fight
item.description: Tech leaders say AI will drive down costs. But slow corporate adoption and the data center build-out create inflation pressures that complicate the Fed’s job.

item.title: New York City Council announces probe into prediction market platforms’ marketing strategies
item.description: In letters to four prediction market platforms, City Council Speaker Julie Menin said the council was also actively considering legislation to address concerns.

item.title: World's largest sovereign wealth fund posts record $184 billion profit as it reveals SpaceX stake for the first time
item.description: The fund — currently valued at around $2.34 trillion — is an investor in more than 7,000 companies across 60 countries.
